messages:
Samira Khan (CSM): Heads-up — BrightWave health review scheduled for Thu 10am PT. Need a focused pack on spend forecasts, token economics, onboarding gaps, and any renewal-risk notes. Can folks drop short updates here? :calendar:
Devon Li (Account Lead): I'll pull the 90-day usage and run a 3-month forecast under current growth assumptions (x1.25/mo). Will flag any big variance drivers.
Jia Park (Solutions Eng): Will add enablement log: workshops done, open enablement tickets, and any lingering tech blockers. Also capture their feedback on the reranker tests.
Rob Meyers (Finance): I'll validate their monthly commit vs actuals and confirm whether budget alerts are configured correctly (80/90%). If not, I'll propose thresholds.
billing-bot: Automated note: BrightWave commit = $18,000/month (Dedicated). Last spend alert triggered 2026-02-28 at 22:13 UTC.
Elaine Torres (BrightWave): Quick context from our side — onboarding delayed by two weeks because of SSO. We're seeing a couple of large generation spikes tied to daily data-ingest jobs; curious if batching could cut cost.
Samira Khan (CSM): Thanks Elaine — please paste an example spike timestamp if you can. Devon, include spikes as separate line items so we can propose fixes.
Devon Li (Account Lead): Preliminary numbers attached below (quick snapshot):
```
- Avg gen tokens / month: 420,000,000
- Avg embed tokens / month: 28,000,000
- Current blended unit cost (approx): $0.00045 / gen-token, $0.0012 / embed-token
- Current monthly spend estimate: ~$2,000 (gen) + ~$34 (embed) = ~$2,034
- 3-month growth scenario (1.25x/month) -> month3 spend ~ $6,350
```
Jia Park (Solutions Eng): From enablement: did two live trainings (API + prompts) and one custom prompt set. Outstanding items: SSO fix, KV cache enablement, and follow-up for reranker evals. Reranker feedback: occasional low-recall on long-tail queries.
Rob Meyers (Finance): Noted. If the spikes are scheduled jobs, we should propose a batching window or move to a cheaper model for background jobs. Also recommend adding a budget alert at 60% to catch ramp earlier.
Samira Khan (CSM): Action: @Devon run a model-fallback cost analysis (current -> small/quantized model) and estimated savings if 30% of traffic moved. Due: EOD Tue.
Samira Khan (CSM): Action: @Jia compile enablement status bullets and open tasks for SSO and KV cache. Due: EOD Mon.
Samira Khan (CSM): Action: @Rob confirm alert thresholds and create a playbook entry for budget overrun (who to notify, escalation). Due: EOD Tue.
Elaine Torres (BrightWave): For the spike sample: 2026-02-20 03:10 UTC — batch job hit the generation endpoint with 12M tokens; it retried a few times. Happy to share logs.
Devon Li (Account Lead): Thanks — that explains the biggest variance. I'll simulate moving that job to a smaller model and to cached prefixes. Quick estimate: moving 12M tokens to 8-bit quantized path + caching would reduce that window from $5.4 -> $1.1 (ballpark). Will include detailed numbers.
Jia Park (Solutions Eng): Also add an enablement suggestion: scheduled jobs should use dedicated API keys with throttling and separate routing policy (lower-cost pool). We can provide a snippet for the customer.
Samira Khan (CSM): Nice. Rob, can you check whether their commit can be reallocated to cover expected ramp next quarter or if we should discuss an add-on?
Rob Meyers (Finance): Will check contract and committed units. If they need an increase, propose a short-term overflow credit or a burst plan to avoid immediate overages.
Samira Khan (CSM): FYI I'll capture customer sentiment / renewal-risk as: Low-medium for now (onboarding delays + cost surprises). If we demonstrate 20-30% potential savings and fix alerts, we should move to low risk.
Devon Li (Account Lead): I'll draft the QBR slide with spend waterfall (baseline, spikes, mitigations, forecast) and share a link here for quick review.
Jia Park (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare a short tech appendix: example routing policy, cache config, and a sample prompt-eval failing case for reranker so PMs can triage.
Samira Khan (CSM): Perfect. Final ask: everyone paste your one-sentence update by EOD Tue so I can assemble the QBR doc for Thurs. :thumbsup:
Elaine Torres (BrightWave): Appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll also confirm whether the batch job can be rescheduled.
Devon Li (Account Lead): One-sentence update by EOD Tue: pulling forecasts + spike mitigation plan.
Jia Park (Solutions Eng): One-sentence: enablement items + KV cache playbook ready.
Rob Meyers (Finance): One-sentence: verified alerts + contract check initiated.
Samira Khan (CSM): Thanks team — I'll assemble and circulate the QBR pack by Wed AM for review. :rotating_light:
